menus.label: Product
menus.items:
Edge Agent Detection | Identify crawlers and LLM fetchers in under 2 ms at the CDN edge.
Semantic HTML Distillation | Strip chrome, scripts, and layout bloat while keeping every fact intact.
Zero Visual Change | Human visitors receive your exact pixel-for-pixel production site.

menus.label: Use cases
menus.items:
Documentation & Knowledge Bases | Cut agent context windows by up to 94% across technical docs.
E-Commerce Catalogs | Serve structured pricing, SKUs, and specs directly to shopping agents.
Editorial & Research | Make long-form journalism and reports cleanly indexable by machines.

Kessler — Advanced materials

Advanced materials for a stronger tomorrow. Ceramic-matrix alloys made with desert sand and solar heat.

At a glance

  • Strength: 200x steel by weight
  • Emissions: 87% lower
  • Plants: Nevada, Atacama, Oman
  • Founded: 2019

Products

  • K-Alloy 7 — structural
  • Basalt fibre — tensile
  • Ceramic matrix — thermal
Book a demo

Case study: Atlas Rail

How Atlas Rail cut track weight by a third in eighteen months.

The challenge

1,200 km of desert line, rails warping above 50 °C every summer.

The result

  • 34% lighter track sections
  • 3.4x longer service life
  • 0 unplanned closures in 2025

We stopped losing summers. — Head of Infrastructure
